description: Delete a NAT policy in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A NAT policy still referenced is refused as in use. A segment delete is not checked against NAT policies, so a policy can hold a segment id that no longer exists. If it is deployed, the delete only marks it for deletion: it keeps carrying traffic, with its name, until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the NAT policy, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The policy_nat_get_* read tools and policy_nat_create return it.

name: policy_nat_delete
